batchId: Claude manual-research batch dc-missing (10 identities that had no profile)
method: Facts taken from fetched pages (mostly Wikipedia and Tolkien Gateway, plus search-result articles); claims a page did not support were left out. No numeric tiers. All records provisional until a different contributor checks them.

characters.continuity: Dark Multiverse Batman from Dark Nights: Metal (2017) and its tie-in one-shot. Not the mainline Bruce Wayne.
characters.summary: Bruce Wayne of Earth -32, chosen by a Green Lantern ring as a child after his parents' murder. His rage and will corrupted the ring into a lethal weapon.

techniques: Power ring pushed past normal limits by his will, with the no-killing restriction overridden
Dark constructs described as stronger than his world's whole Green Lantern Corps
Murdered every Green Lantern and Guardian in his universe
Beat Hal Jordan and laid waste to Coast City

weaknesses: Raven nearly beat him by seizing control of his constructs
Defeated with the other Dark Knights by the Justice League

sources.supports: Dawnbreaker: ring chose young Bruce of Earth -32; will overrode the no-kill limit; dark constructs; killed his Corps; fought Hal Jordan; nearly beaten by Raven.
Dawnbreaker origin: young Bruce chosen by a power ring, corrupts it with rage and murders every Green Lantern and Oan in his universe.
Seven evil Batmen from the Dark Multiverse serve Barbatos; the Justice League defeats the Dark Knights.

characters.summary: Bruce Wayne of Earth -1, who injected himself with a modified Doomsday virus to stop a Superman who had turned on the world, becoming a human/Doomsday hybrid.

techniques: Doomsday's strength with Batman's intellect
Kryptonite breath
Killed his own world's Superman
Beat the main Superman in Dark Nights: Metal #3 until the Flash intervened

Devastator origin: modified Doomsday virus makes Batman a human/Doomsday hybrid who kills Superman and then infects everyone.
Seven evil Batmen from the Dark Multiverse serve Barbatos; the Justice League defeats the Dark Knights.

characters.continuity: Post-Crisis DC Comics: Emerald Twilight (1994), Zero Hour and The Final Night.
characters.summary: Hal Jordan after Coast City's destruction: he seized the Central Power Battery, took the name Parallax and tried to rewrite history. Later stories attribute this to a fear parasite.

techniques: Solid-light constructs and energy on a far greater scale after absorbing the Central Power Battery
Reality alteration and time manipulation
Destroyed the Green Lantern Corps, killing Kilowog and Sinestro
Reignited the Sun in The Final Night

mechanisms: Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: Exhausted most of his power in Zero Hour and was shot by Green Arrow
Gave his life reigniting the Sun

sources.supports: Parallax: Hal Jordan destroys the Corps, tries to rewrite history in Zero Hour, sacrifices himself in Final Night; powers include constructs, reality and time alteration.
Hal attacked Oa, took the Central Power Battery, killed Kilowog and Sinestro, was shot by Green Arrow in Zero Hour and died in Final Night.

characters.continuity: Mainline DC Comics, Green Lantern (2021, Geoffrey Thorne) and John Stewart: The Emerald Knight #1.
characters.summary: John Stewart after absorbing the Godstorm while confronting the New God Esak. He ascended to godhood and took the name Emerald Knight.

techniques: Godstorm power, described as placing him above Superman
Acts as the power source for other Lanterns' rings
Defeated Esak and stopped the Lightbringer

mechanisms: Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: The Source later split him into two beings at half power each

sources.supports: Stewart absorbs the Godstorm facing Esak, defeats him, stops the Lightbringer and becomes the new battery for the rings.
The ascended John Stewart is separated by the Source into a Green Lantern and a Source-powered Emerald Knight at half power each.
John Stewart's baseline powers: constructs, flight, force fields, energy projection.
